replies.text: Measured now: the selected label is ink rgb(4,120,87) on the mint tint, 5.07:1 (hover 4.90:1, active 4.74:1), so the text passes 4.5:1. What is weak is the selection fill itself: the 16% mint tint is 1.08:1 against the white panel, so the selected row barely stands out. Do you mean that? Recommendation: keep the tint and add a 2px ink bar at the row start (5.48:1). The question also goes to the grill session.

replies.author: claude-opus-5-5
replies.text: My first answer was wrong: it measured the light scheme, and you looked at the dark one. Cause: the tree sat on the fixed class et-color--brand-on-light, so the dark scheme kept the dark green light-scheme ink, at 2.23:1. Fixed: the ink now follows the scheme. Dark scheme now: mint ink rgb(0,255,161) on the selection fill, 9.24:1. Light scheme: 5.07:1. The same fault hit the select panel and the form-field error text; both are fixed too. Please reload and check.
